issue_context.title: Change Detection Benchmarks
issue_context.body:
## What problem does this solve or what need does it fill?
bevy_ecs's benchmarks currently do not cover change detection use cases.

## What solution would you like?
Add benchmarks for added and changed components.

## What alternative(s) have you considered?
Flying blind into change detection optimizations.
comments: I'll try to tackle this one.

review_comments: I would prefer to have them, but won't block on it.
Let's focus on merging that PR then, we'll improve on that later
generic helper to avoid duplication, see https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/issues/5161.
A quick search for `deterministic_rand` in the PR changeset doesn't bring anything up - what is this used for?
Not used indeed ; I thought it might be useful if we want to test change detection in shuffled dataset.. but if a simple benchmark is good enough it's best to keep that out for now.
It's now used for shuffling the `few_changed_detection` bench entities
Could these be zero sized? I suppose it doesn't matter, since they're never queried anyway?
